message: Hi Alex, it's Priya at Ironside Auto Care, quick question before we talk: did an AI write this email?
reply: Hi Priya, honest answer: I used AI to help draft and research it, but I wrote and reviewed it myself before sending. I do the same with site audits — AI helps spot issues, I verify and fix them by hand. No guarantees made, just a clear list of what's broken and a flat $900 to fix it. Happy to share the audit if useful.
